evidence: Running the repro under jax==0.10.1 and jaxlib==0.10.1 on CPU prints actual=[[inf, inf, inf], [inf, 4.76837158203125e-07, 13.815508842468262]] while the expected value for the smallest positive float32 subnormal is 103.2789306640625; the script raises AssertionError because the subnormal input is returned as inf.
steps: Create and activate a local virtual environment.
Install the pinned repro dependencies from requirements.txt.
Run repro.py through run_repro.sh on the CPU backend.
